title: Sodium Hydroxide and Sodium Carbonate
notes: **NaOH (caustic soda):** produced by electrolysis of brine (Chlor-alkali process). Strong base, absorbs $CO_2$ to form $Na_2CO_3$, reacts with acids to form salts, dissolves amphoteric metals like Al and Zn with $H_2$ evolution.
**$Na_2CO_3$ (washing soda):** produced by Solvay process. Hydrolyses in water to give alkaline solution: $CO_3^{2-} + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HCO_3^- + OH^-$.
**Action with $CO_2$:** $Na_2CO_3 + H_2O + CO_2 \rightarrow 2NaHCO_3$. This is why washing soda forms crusts in air.
**Action with $SO_2$:** $Na_2CO_3 + SO_2 \rightarrow Na_2SO_3 + CO_2$. Used in flue gas desulphurization.
**Uses of NaOH:** soap, paper, aluminium production (Bayer process), drain cleaner, pH control.
**Uses of $Na_2CO_3$:** laundry detergent, glass manufacture, water softening, paper industry.
